meaning: On the entire integer past of a real-valued stock, a fixed positive epsilon, one real past lower bound L, and uniform per-step growth by at least epsilon are jointly incompatible. Backward induction gives S(now−n)+n*epsilon≤S(now) for every natural n. The lower bound then gives n*epsilon≤S(now)−L for every n, contradicting the Archimedean property of Real. The Int grid and finite Archimedean real values are fixed mathematical background; no finite elapsed-time budget, temporal first event, finite event cardinality, causal well-foundedness or global entropy law is a premise. This is an actual conditional constraint on a beginningless discrete resource profile, not a proof that every temporal order has a first instant. No preferred premise is rejected. Uniform positivity and the whole-past lower bound remain open restrictions for any physical application; strict pointwise growth alone is insufficient, as the separate controls calibrate. The old SUPERTASK-UNIT-COST-UNBOUNDED result is orientation, not an imported inference: no literal premise-minimality comparison to its closed unit-duration theorem is claimed. Relative to that discussion, this route omits a finite TIME budget and instead makes the RESOURCE bound and uniform growth explicit. Intended and actual root-premise delta none.
